description:
1881 Hvem Ringer® – see who’s calling before you answer
With 1881 Hvem Ringer®, you can see who’s calling while your phone is ringing. The app automatically looks up incoming numbers using Opplysningen 1881®, helping you identify both important calls and unwanted callers before you decide whether to answer.

Whether it’s a customer, a delivery driver, your doctor’s office, or an important call from your child’s daycare, 1881 Hvem Ringer® helps you know who’s trying to reach you.

1881 is Best in Test
An independent study conducted by Kantar shows that Opplysningen 1881® provides the highest number of correct results compared with other directory services in Norway. 1881 has the highest overall share of correct results and performs significantly better in text searches for names, addresses, and businesses.

With 1881 Hvem Ringer®, you get:
• See who’s calling while your phone is ringing
• Automatic number lookup using Opplysningen 1881®
• Alerts for sales and spam calls
• Better control over which calls you want to answer
• Unlimited searches in Opplysningen 1881® without distracting ads
• Look up missed calls
• Update and organize your contacts

Don’t miss important calls
An unknown number doesn’t necessarily mean an unimportant call. With automatic number lookup, you can see who’s calling before you answer – even if the number isn’t saved in your contacts.

1881 Hvem Ringer® subscription
The app requires an active 1881 Hvem Ringer® or 1881 Mobilsøk subscription. If you don’t already have a subscription, you’ll be offered the option to subscribe in the app when you get started.

New customers get a 30-day free trial. You can cancel your subscription at any time.

Search Opplysningen 1881®
Use the app to search for names, phone numbers, addresses, businesses, and industries. You can also find nearby businesses and services, such as restaurants, pharmacies, and gas stations.

Update your contacts
Save new contacts or update existing ones with information from Opplysningen 1881®. You’ll also have quick access to call, send an SMS, or email your contacts.

How to activate “See Who’s Calling” on iPhone:
1. Go to Settings
2. Select Apps > Phone
3. Select Call Blocking & Identification
4. Enable 1881 Hvem Ringer®

Privacy
We care about your privacy. Opplysningen 1881® cannot see who is calling you, who you call, or your contacts.

Opplysningen 1881® is Norway’s most widely used directory service, helping you find reliable information about people, phone numbers, addresses, and businesses.

See who’s calling – before you answer.
With 1881 Hvem Ringer®, you don’t have to wonder who’s on the other end of the line.
